ana: heads-up: quick design sync on prompt-sets & evals UI — focus areas: approval microcopy, staged vs immediate flows, keyboard range-select, diff heatmap accessibility. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE (frames 70-74) :spiral_calendar:
kevin: TL;DR: staged approvals by default for multi-review teams; instant approve for single-click small batches. need clear CTA copy to avoid confusion.
maria: Agree. Propose copy rules: If action is immediate -> `Approve N examples`; if staged -> `Stage N for approval`; for finalizing -> `Finalize approvals (creates audit entry)`. Add short subtitle where helpful.\jun: For small batches (<=30) allow instant approve + undo toast (8s). For 31-400 -> stage. >400 -> start async job (show job id & progress).	om: Accessibility notes: undo toast must be role=alert and announced. After undo or finalize, focus should move to a logical stable element (table header or job card). Also make job card keyboard-focusable.\kevin: Keyboard: support range-select with shift+arrow and a single-key action to stage (`S`) or approve (`A`). Document in shortcuts modal and show a little helper when first using table.\maria: Microcopy nit: change "Select all in view" -> "Select visible examples (approx.)" with exact count in tooltip or in the sidebar when staging. Avoid implying billing counts.\jun: UX: when staging, show a subtle badge on staged rows and allow per-row unstage. Badge needs accessible name for SR users — use `aria-label="staged for approval"`.	om: For compact diffs, eva-bot flagged low contrast on inline markers at smaller sizes. Suggest increasing font to 13px 600 or switching token to #072146. Also add a pattern overlay option for heatmap for colorblindness.\eva-bot: visual-scan: compact-labels at 12px fail AA. Logged ticket: RG-ux-compact-501. Recommend 13px 600 or color token #072146.\kevin: Scorecard legend: PMs find "No judgement yet" confusing. Replace with "Not scored" and add a tiny info icon linking to a short tooltip: "0 = fail ... 5 = excellent". Tooltip should be reachable by keyboard.\maria: Approve CTA copy example: `Approve 12 examples — marks them passed for this suite. Undo available via banner.` For staged flow: `Stage 12 for approval — reviewers can finalize later.`\jun: Finalize modal copy: `Finalize approvals — this will mark staged examples as passed and create an audit entry. Revert allowed within X hours.` Show `Preview impact` link for admins.	om: Keyboard a11y tests failing for inline comment composer in compact mode (rs-compact-099) — composer steals arrow navigation. Likely focus or event propagation issue. I'll take it.\kevin: Also add ctrl+z to undo while toast visible, but only activate when the toast is focused/visible to avoid conflicts.\maria: QA checklist additions: 1) SR walkthrough for staging/finalize 2) keyboard range-select + action 3) undo announce & focus restore 4) heatmap pattern toggles 5) scorecard tooltip keyboard access.\jun: small UX: annotated diffs should auto-collapse unchanged blocks. Provide an "expand all" affordance and ensure aria-expanded is present.\ana: Quick poll: staged-by-default + compact persisted toggle + the microcopy rules above? :thumbsup:
